evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic maxim that renders a technical reliability claim into plain parallel clauses — the document's register signature: crystallizing operational doctrine as a matched-antithesis proverb.
